# Calnivo

> Free online calculators for finance, health, math and everyday tasks. Each page shows the formula, a worked example, assumptions and sources. Inputs stay in the browser.

## Finance
- [Mortgage calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/mortgage): monthly payment with taxes, insurance and HOA
- [Loan calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/loan): payment and total interest
- [Compound interest calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/compound-interest): savings growth with monthly deposits
- [Income tax calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/income-tax): 2025 and 2026 IRS federal brackets

## Health
- [BMI calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/bmi): body mass index and category
- [Calorie calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/calorie): TDEE and macros using Mifflin-St Jeor

## Math and everyday
- [Percentage calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/percentage): four modes with examples
- [Scientific calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/scientific): trig, logs, powers, factorial
- [Age calculator](https://calnivocalc.com/calculators/age): exact age in years, months, days

## About
- [Methodology](https://calnivocalc.com/methodology): how calculators are built, sources, corrections log
- [About](https://calnivocalc.com/about): founders and editorial process
- [Blog](https://calnivocalc.com/blog): in-depth guides on mortgage, tax, BMI, compound interest
